title: HSACO allocation inspection cannot reach the portable profile consumer
observation: The existing AMDGCN inspector reads physical VGPR/private/LDS counts, but portable report replay assumes kernel.cubin, the collection CLI requires cuobjdump, and non-CUBIN profiles reject compiled observations. The actual DTK replay has fixed LDS0 and launch dynamic LDS8192 for a large tile; these are distinct and must both remain visible. The initial duplicate-static-LDS hypothesis was rejected by that replay. Separate AMDGPU stack storage is not observed.
proposed_change: Connect existing HSACO inspection to code-object-bound portable reports and the existing profile/author-feedback CLI. Preserve CUDA v1 report replay, use generic binary identity for HSACO, retain fixed and launch-dynamic LDS separately, and report unobserved stack as null. Keep NCU metrics, dynamic spill traffic and calibrated latency claims absent.
promotion_disposition: In development. Require retained-source offline compile/replay on the actual DTK toolchain, affected contracts, full Corpus and independent review. No performance or achieved-occupancy claim.
